description: Three adversarial reviewer personas found the draft evidence-safe but too concession-heavy, insufficiently explicit about the audit decision, and incomplete on 4G4H's per-run telemetry request.
A blind evidence judge found the frozen E1 disappearance verdict used a normal-approximation MDE, omitted the preregistered multiplicity step, and failed the finite-sample MDE gate.
All four E1 comparisons were relabeled inconclusive; Tinker linkage, DAPO treatment changes, private-artifact limits, and adoption operationalization were corrected; the evidence judge returned PASS.
AC and score-change judges accepted the positive-first, reviewer-specific responses after surgical wording fixes; no further additions were judged beneficial.
